newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda sells $2.9 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Uganda sells $2.9 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Uganda sold three billion Ugandan shillings ($2.9 million) of the 91-day main category of treasury bills at the weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
The bank said it sold 2.7882 billion on competitive and 211.8 million on non-competitive basis at an annualised yield of 9.859 percent, a 0.021 percent decrease from last week.
Demand for T-bills was worth 4.55 billion shillings this week compared to 3.0 billion shillings last week.

There was a significant fall in the price of 97.532-97.449 this week to 57.570-57.513 last week, representing a 39.962 and 39.936 percent fall respectively. Bank officials attributed to the low interest rates quoted by buyers.
The bank invited tenders for 5.0 billion shillings of treasury bills in the 91-day category for auction next week.
